newsitem.title: USA: Teleport Communications wins Nebraska nod.
newsitem.headline: Teleport Communications wins Nebraska nod.

text.p: Teleport Communications Group Inc said Wednesday the Nebraska Public Service Commission has authorized the company to provide local telephone exchange service in the Omaha metropolitan area.
It said the decision means the company is now a certified local exchange carrier and a "peer carrier" to the local monopoly when it comes to interconnecting the two companies' networks.
Teleport Communications has networks in 57 major markets nationwide, including Omaha.
